science_sections.why: The Kuiper Belt is the trans-Neptunian remnant of the protoplanetary disc — 30 to 50 AU, dominated by ice. Pluto, Eris, Haumea, Makemake live here.
The classical KBOs orbit between 42 and 48 AU in low-eccentricity, low-inclination orbits — they have been mostly undisturbed since the early system.
The scattered-disc subpopulation (Eris, Sedna) sits at high inclinations (30°+) — gravitationally scattered by Neptune's outward migration and currently spreading the belt vertically.
